subject: Launch gating edges + enablement lanes: owners, windows, and exceptions
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Launch gating edges + enablement lanes: owners, windows, and exceptions

Team —

We need to lock the launch gating edges and who owns each enablement lane for the December rollout. This thread is to collect owners, confirm the go/no-go windows, and capture any exception paths (both product and infra). High-level ask: by EOD Friday (Dec 4) we should have owners and an initial runbook draft ready so Marissa can schedule training the week of Dec 7.

Proposed gating lanes (please confirm ownership):
- Safety & compliance (SOC2/data retention) — owner: Vivek?
- Runtime/throughput (slot allocation + model variants) — owner: Ben?
- Docs & enablement (customer-facing guide + internal runbook) — owner: Marissa
- Support & escalation (oncall rotations + triage doc) — owner: Grace
- Go-live window & canary policy (percentages, fallback) — owner: Laura

Immediate asks:
1) Reply with confirmed owner or propose alternate.
2) List any blocking items that would push the window (dependencies, audits, infra capacity).
3) Attach any draft artifacts (enablement deck, runbook sections, staging matrix).

I've attached an initial enablement deck and an early runbook draft. I added a staging matrix CSV with suggested slices.

If external ops (Acme cloudops) need to be spoken to for capacity, I can loop them in once owners are set.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Program Manager, Product Launches
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch gating edges + enablement lanes: owners, windows, and exceptions

Tessa —

Happy to own Safety & compliance lane. Quick notes from my side:
- SOC scope for this rollout is limited to runtime telemetry retention and audit logs. We need confirmation from Security that the current retention policy meets the customer's requirement (Jen Smith at FinBank flagged longer retention).
- If FinBank needs 90-day logs, we may need a short exception to the default retention policy while we upgrade KMS key rotation (INF-7821). That will be a 2-week infra task.
- I'll coordinate with CloudOps (cloudops@acme.com) to validate encryption-in-transit for customer VPC peering; I can loop them in once we confirm the go-live window.

Blocking items:
- Security approval on retention: ETA Dec 3 (Security PO has a quick review scheduled).
- KMS upgrade dependency if retention exception required (approx 10 business days).

I attached a one-pager (pasted into the runbook-draft) with the minimal compliance gating criteria.

-Vivek

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Launch gating edges + enablement lanes: owners, windows, and exceptions

Thanks Tessa — I can take Docs & Enablement. Quick updates from PM/Docs:
- I reviewed the enablement-deck-v1.pptx and added speaker notes for the customer demo flow. I'll drop a link to the canonical deck in the Drive folder (see related links).
- Proposed training plan: two 60-minute sessions for Sales/SE (Dec 8 and Dec 10) and one 90-minute deep-dive for Support on Dec 9. Can we finalize owners + runbook by EOD Dec 4 to lock these slots?
- Staging matrix: I've updated the matrix with required test cases for the canary slice (see staging-matrix.csv).

One ask on the go-live window: the PM team prefers a phased 3-day ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) starting Dec 14 to minimize blast radius. If Security needs more time on retention, we should move the start to Dec 21.

Related items: JIRA INF-7821 tracks the retention/KMS work (linked above). I'll add action items in there and tag the Docs epic.

Attachments: staging-matrix.csv (slices and acceptance), small edits to runbook-draft.md included inline.

-Marissa

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 11:18, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Finalize: gating edges & enablement lanes (decision record)

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. Summary and decisions:
- Owners confirmed: Vivek (Safety), Ben (Runtime), Marissa (Docs), Grace (Support), Laura (Go-live policy).
- Go-live window: we will aim for phased ramp starting Dec 14 (10% -> 50% -> 100%). If Security cannot clear the retention exception by Dec 10, move to Dec 21.
- Blockers: Security retention decision (Dec 3 target) and KMS work (INF-7821) — Vivek to update JIRA if exception needed.
- Training slots confirmed (Marissa to schedule).
- External ops: Tessa, please loop cloudops@acme.com for final capacity sign-off (target Dec 8).

Action items (owner / due):
- Vivek: confirm retention status in INF-7821 / Dec 3.
- Marissa: finalize deck + schedule training / Dec 6.
- Ben: validate staging throughput and post canary thresholds / Dec 7.
- Grace: publish support triage doc and oncall rota / Dec 9.
- Tessa: send final runbook to execs and external ops / Dec 8.

I'll mark this as the decision record and close the loop once those items are green. If anyone needs to raise an exception after Dec 8, tag me directly so we can evaluate trade-offs.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
VP Product Operations, Redwood Inference
